notes: House title pattern is now "name: payload — b0b.dev" with an em dash before the brand on every page (draft set mixed " | ", " - ", and " — ", plus one bare "b0b" on artifact.html); index.html is the single exception, leading with the brand and site tagline ("b0b.dev — signal over noise: OSINT research & countermeasures") instead of its old report-plus-map descriptor, which competed with report.html and map.html. The six tones pages were normalized into one family construction across title, headline, and description (lowercase tool name, colon, concrete payload — e.g. "healing tones: solfeggio frequency generator", "ARC Shield: LRAD detection & phase cancellation"), tone lab's short headline was expanded to the family shape, and the multipack meta was rephrased ("Schumann-carrier binaurals, noise beds") to break its near-overlap with tones-protective while keeping the 20-22 kHz ultrasonic sweep as its differentiator; map.html's title dropped the vague "surveillance, Epstein network" list for "surveillance sites & Epstein network". Casing was unified to the site's lowercase terminal voice (acronyms and proper nouns — OSINT, LRAD, Schumann, Epstein-Maxwell, PROJECT ANGLERFISH, SPECTRA — keep caps), en dashes in ranges became ASCII hyphens (174-963 Hz), and stray " - " separators in headlines became em dashes. All lengths verified by script: titles 50-63 chars, metas 149-162, ogs 157-194, headlines 52-107; pairwise token-similarity check confirms no near-identical titles or metas. jsonldType needed no changes — exactly one WebSite (index), Articles for report, shield-guide, and the attack-vector writeup, WebApplication for the interactive tools (countermeasures kept as WebApplication since its copy describes on-page tools, not a link hub). Nothing was genericized; every specific (1,100+ sites, 7.83 Hz, 23 sections, Flock ALPR, CASSOWARY ORCA AGILITY) survives.
